history.action: 🌌 SPRINT 3 IMPLEMENTATION ARCHITECTURE (C806) — Created docs/frontier/sprint3-implementation-architecture-c806.md. Unified technical blueprint synthesizing all 4 SaaS specs (Auth #181, Billing #182, Managed Exec #189, API Gateway #190). Database schema (7 tables: users, subscriptions, repositories, scheduled_cycles, cycle_history, api_keys, usage_events). Shared TypeScript types for User, Subscription, Repository, CycleExecution, ApiKey. 5-week phased build sequence with parallel tracks. Service integration points (Auth→Billing→Dispatch→API). R-013: 71/71 verified ✅. 384 consecutive (C421-806).

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Synthesizing 4 independent specs into unified implementation architecture provides clear dependency map and build sequence for Engineering. Shared types + database schema enable parallel development without integration conflicts. Lesson: L439 — After spec completion phase, create unified implementation architecture before Sprint start; reduces coordination overhead during execution.
